title: The Tune at the Gate  (La melodía junto al portón)

segments.t: Hannah acude al portón abierto del patio junto con Arthur y Evelyn, y saluda con amabilidad al vecino del sombrero gris que sigue escuchando desde la acera de la calle Linden. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
You know each other, Arthur?!
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
Descubramos línea por línea el desenlace musical de este episodio.
Excuse me, sir, would you like to come inside for a warm cup of tea?
'Disculpe, señor, ¿le gustaría pasar a tomar una taza de té caliente?'
Wait... our neighbor from the violin shop at number ten?!
'Espera... ¿¡nuestro vecino de la tienda de violines del número diez!?'
You know each other, Arthur?!
'¿¡Se conocen, Arthur!?'
Thirty years ago, he brought his violin here every Friday at six!
'¡Hace treinta años traía su violín aquí todos los viernes a las seis!'
Wait, look at our old postcard: 'Save two chairs for the baker and the teacher'!
'Espera, mira nuestra vieja postal: "Guarden dos sillas para el panadero y el profesor".'
He was the music teacher who played Friday duets with your aunt!
'¡Él era el profesor de música que tocaba dúos los viernes con tu tía!'
He just asked me who finally finished the second half of her May waltz!
'¡Me acaba de preguntar quién terminó por fin la segunda mitad de su vals de mayo!'
What did he say when he heard my sixteen bars through the window, Arthur?
'¿Qué dijo cuando oyó mis dieciséis compases a través de la ventana, Arthur?'
He had tears in his eyes. He said it sounded just like her voice!
'Tenía lágrimas en los ojos. ¡Dijo que sonaba exactamente igual que la voz de ella!'
Did you invite him to our grand opening this Friday at six o'clock?!
'¿¡Lo invitaste a nuestra gran inauguración este viernes a las seis en punto!?'
He promised to bring his violin, and ten neighbors from down the street!
'¡Prometió traer su violín y a diez vecinos de más abajo en la calle!'
Ten extra neighbors?! Tessa is going to need twice as many lemons by Friday!
'¿¡Diez vecinos más!? ¡Tessa va a necesitar el doble de limones para el viernes!'
Escuchemos por última vez este reencuentro frente al portón.

El antiguo compañero de dúo reconoció el vals a través de la ventana abierta y volverá el viernes a las seis con su violín y media calle Linden. Así termina este quinto episodio: nos vemos muy pronto en el gran final de la temporada. Hasta la próxima.
Have a great evening!
